# Test fixtures

The V0A policy fixtures use synthetic `0xc0ffee…` addresses. The
`krakmask_ink_buy.policy.json` file is the bounded V0B exception: its exact
KRAKMASK/WETH9 addresses are the user-selected live-market fixture verified by
the dual-provider Ink adapter.

The fixture is not an endorsement, a safety claim, a recommendation, or an
assertion that the named token is legitimate or tradeable. The chain id
`57073` is Ink mainnet.
